text:
harper: quick check  new Service Metrics mock has req/s + p95(ms). space is tight; i want something compact but not misleading. thoughts?
mina: i hate dual axes. proposal: percentile-clamp at 95th for visuals, show a subtle overflow gutter indicator (+) when values exceed the clamp. hover shows raw.
lee: nice. call it 'percentile-clamp' rather than "cap" so it's clear it's intentional, not broken. what about smoothing?
harper: smoothing should not hide extremes. suggestion: compute smoothing on raw stream, draw smoothed line and render raw points with clamp applied in the plot.
mina: for legend, use inline unit pills (vis: "Throughput · req/s", "p95 · ms") and in ARIA read full words: "Throughput, requests per second" etc.
lee: accessibility: provide a hidden summary paragraph under chart: "Throughput (requests per second) and 95th percentile latency (milliseconds). Visuals clamp values above the 95th percentile; use hover or the table to see raw extremes."
harper: copy for overflow gutter tooltip: "Some values exceed display range; click to open raw table." short and actionable.
mina: perf/UI nit: include a tiny sparkline-only row under the main chart for quick glance of extremes over longer windows; clicking the sparkline opens a popover with full-resolution data and CSV export.
lee: formatting rules: SI short for req/s, integer + 'ms' for latency. code note: formatTick(series) -> series.unit==='req/s' ? siShort(v) : `${Math.round(v)} ms`.
ux-bot: summary created: "Use 95th-percentile visual clamp with overflow gutter; render smoothed line computed on raw data; show raw values on hover/popover; unit pills in legend + SR-friendly hidden summary; sparkline mini-row for quick extreme view."
harper: cool. @mina can you add the gutter indicator and popover flow to Figma? @lee will draft the SR summary HTML. i'll file the infra ticket for the percentile compute.
mina: on it. :white_check_mark:
